zh_confusable_char_map.description: CJK char-level variant fold map applied by normalize_text after NFKC + the built-in traditional fold. Maps rare lookalike/homophone substitute chars and extra traditional forms onto the canonical simplified char, so obfuscated lures like 荩块 still match the 尽快 keyword. HARD RULE: only chars that appear in NO seeded keyword may be folded here (PhraseMatcher patterns stay raw), which is why 検/証/応/営/転/馬/凍/優/約/積/貼/補/鎖/餘 are deliberately absent.

zh_compound_char_map.description: Split-character (拆字/拼接字) sequences folded onto the single canonical char: attackers decompose a hanzi into components (骗→马扁, 赌→贝者, 钱→钅戋, 银→钅艮) to dodge keyword scanners. Keys match leftmost-longest after char folds, and the multi-char pass must be re-applied until fixpoint so chained substitutions (车专帐 → 转帐 → 转账) fully resolve; 馬扁 is kept separately because 馬 cannot be char-folded (it appears in seeded keywords). Separator splicing (微.信 / 微 信 / zero-width joins) is handled by NFKC, invisible-char stripping and the compact CJK second pass.

zh_variant_phrase_map.description: Word-level folds for variants built from COMMON chars that must never be folded char-wide (块/威/薇/徽/蜜/帐...): 尽块→尽快, 威信→微信, 转帐→转账. Exact n-gram replacement only, so legit text like 一块钱 / 供应商威胁取消合同 / 发票 / 帐户已暂停 (seeded in its own right) is untouched. 帐户/帐号 are deliberately NOT folded because the seed keywords ship both spellings.
